parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the IDaaS EIAM instance.

parameters.name: TrustedOriginId
parameters.description: The ID of the trusted origin.
